title: Nightfall Duel｜夜域世界圖
status: 地理配置概念稿，非定稿
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a beautiful original WORLD MAP for the established dark-fantasy game NIGHTFALL DUEL. One complete landscape 16:9 illustrated cartographic plate, high resolution, suitable as an actual game world-map concept. This is a MAP viewed from above with small hand-drawn isometric landmarks, not a scene, not a diagram of boxes, not a collage. Refined ink engraving on aged charcoal-and-ivory vellum, antique gold linework, muted deep teal waters, charcoal violet encroaching mists, faint ember illumination around populated towns. Museum-quality fantasy atlas, restrained ornament, clear geographic hierarchy, elegantly legible TRADITIONAL CHINESE labels, generous spacing, intricate mountains, drainage-consistent rivers flowing into sea, wooded valleys, coastal cliffs, roads, bridges, small town pictograms. Fine compass rose and understated decorative border; no scale bar because distances are not canonical. No modern elements or game HUD.

Title centered at top exactly "NIGHTFALL DUEL", subtitle "夜域世界圖". Small caption under subtitle exactly "地理配置概念稿 · 非定稿". This qualifier is important: canonical story gives places but not geography.

A single varied large landmass spanning most of frame with rugged northern mountains, eastern shadowed inland wastes, a western inhabited river valley and southern coastline with offshore rocks. Balance negative space and detailed landmarks. Locations are proposed cartographic placements, not established countries:
- West-central fertile river junction: compact large walled city with an imposing BELL TOWER and warm lights. Main label "暮鐘城市". Small adjacent civic buildings labeled "暮鐘協會"; small tower-adjacent guard cloister labeled "守誓鐘樓". Do NOT depict a force-field dome. Bell technology transfers night elsewhere, does not annihilate it.
- Near that city, separate scholarly complex with brass observatory roofs, a damaged burned wing: "曜火研究區".
- A discreet ruined fortified estate beside the same city's outer road: "尺烏舊據點". These institutions are not separate sovereign countries.
- Southwestern upland border district: modest rescue outpost and winding trail to higher ground, label "渡垣接應站". No giant fort, no permanent magical safe barrier.
- Central and southeastern lowlands: several small inhabited villages with sparse lights, label region "灰地聚落".
- Far northeastern old ruined city partly reclaimed by mineral ravines, visible tiny muted violet crystal icons in the mines, label "古老災區"; nearby distinct label "暮晶礦床". Crystals form over LONG periods in ancient death zones, never instantaneously behind an advancing mist front.
- East-central valley: abandoned fenced research-site ruin, label "第一號晶化觀測區". Subtle archival circle, no image of a child's origin or experimental procedure.
- A small mountain-side dwelling with a single lamp on the central northern trail: "最後藏身處". Do not show missing father location.
- Broad irregular wisps of ink-black and violet mist crossing the eastern map, label "夜域侵襲帶". This represents transient incursion, not a permanent political territory.
- A lightly hatched SECRET planning overlay across part of the grayland, distinct from existing old crystal mines, labeled "熟地（機密規劃）". This is an administrative sacrifice designation, not a separate country or an instant mineral field.

Two restrained route types, not a spaghetti web: one thin antique gold dashed curve from the big bell city toward grayland with label "移夜方向示意"; one muted teal dotted route linking grayland settlements via mountain pass to the rescue outpost, label "撤離路線示意". Arrows show illustrative planning only, not confirmed future movements. Do not map the heroes as exact simultaneous travel paths.
Compact cartographic legend bottom-left with tiny pictograms and exactly these concise labels: "暮鐘據點", "聚落", "遺址", "暮晶礦床". Small footnote lower edge: "夜域邊界與移夜路線僅為示意". Optional small top-right seal text "世界觀設定圖".
Keep title, place labels and route captions unobscured and correctly written in Traditional Chinese. No invented proper place names, no readable fake lore paragraphs. No characters, faces, blood, corpses, or monsters. The mood is civilization clinging to light while power redistributes darkness.
revisionPrompt: Edit this world map with only precise cartographic corrections. Preserve all terrain, artwork, map title, border, city locations, and existing canonical place labels. 1) Reverse the TEAL dotted evacuation route arrow: it must START at the grayland settlements toward the lower center-right and travel WEST/LEFT to the rescue station labeled 渡垣接應站 at lower left. Place the teal arrowhead ONLY at the LEFT end nearest 渡垣接應站, pointing LEFT toward that station; remove the current right-pointing teal arrowhead on the right end. Keep label 撤離路線示意. 2) Remove ALL invented geographical names printed across seas or mountains: 黯海 at upper left, 暮潮海 at left, 星隕海 at right, 沉暮灣 at bottom, 極北山脈 near upper right. Fill their former areas seamlessly with underlying sea/mountain textures. Do not invent replacement names. 3) Keep the GOLD dashed 移夜方向示意 arrow pointing RIGHT from 暮鐘城市 to 灰地聚落 as currently drawn. Preserve the important subtitle 地理配置概念稿 · 非定稿. Preserve labels 暮鐘協會, 守誓鐘樓, 曜火研究區, 尺烏舊據點, 最後藏身處, 第一號晶化觀測區, 古老災區, 暮晶礦床, 夜域侵襲帶, 熟地（機密規劃）. No other changes. Wide 16:9.
note: 原稿未定義地理、距離與國界。地圖含完整世界觀機密與後續地點，不代表角色起初掌握的資訊；夜域範圍及移夜、撤離路線僅為示意。
